categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Jufei Optoelectronics Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of SMD LED products, focusing on LED packaging. Its products serve applications in mobile phones, computers, LCD TVs, display systems, automotive electronics, smart lighting, health monitoring, smart wearables, and optical sensing. The company also expands into semiconductor packaging and optical film materials, including optocouplers, optical devices, and optical modules.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced LED packaging technologies including Mini LED and Micro LED for backlight and direct display applications. It employs order-driven production with rolling material demand forecasts and digitalized management systems such as JIT, BI, SAP, and MES. The firm emphasizes R&D with over 750 patents, focusing on ultra-thin, low light decay, high color rendering, and high reliability LED technologies, alongside innovations in optical films and semiconductor packaging.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international brands such as Hisense, Changhong, Huawei, Xiaomi, Skyworth, Samsung, LG, Sony, Panasonic, SAIC, GAC, Cadillac, BYD, and Li Auto. The company serves consumer electronics, automotive (including new energy vehicles), smart wearables, and professional display markets globally, with strong presence in China, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Turkey, and India.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Huizhou, and Wuhu, and has a subsidiary in Hong Kong for international trade. Its sales cover domestic regions including South China, East China, North China, Southwest, Northeast, and Northwest, and it actively expands overseas markets, maintaining a growing global market share.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jufei Optoelectronics operates in the midstream of the LED supply chain, specializing in LED packaging and module assembly. It sources raw materials directly from manufacturers and supplies finished LED components and modules to downstream customers such as panel makers, consumer electronics brands, and automotive Tier 1 suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in Mini LED and Micro LED technologies, automotive-grade LEDs, high-power LEDs, and optical films. It invests heavily in R&D to enhance product performance, reliability, and cost efficiency, collaborating with universities and industry partners. Strategic initiatives include expanding semiconductor packaging, optical sensing, and laser applications, alongside digital transformation and international market penetration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of LED products and related components, supplemented by agency sales. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns. Its business model focuses on providing high-quality, cost-effective LED solutions tailored to customer needs across various applications.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Nichia Corporation (Japan), Seoul Semiconductor (South Korea), Everlight Electronics (Taiwan), Hongli Zhihui Group (China), Ruifeng Optoelectronics (China), and others. Jufei Optoelectronics is positioned as a leading domestic player in backlight LED packaging and is rapidly growing its global market share, especially in Mini LED and automotive LED segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.05 billion, a 21.54% increase from 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 339.6 million, up 47.63%. Total assets reached about RMB 5.99 billion, with net assets of RMB 3.71 billion, reflecting steady growth and expanding scale. The company maintains strong cash flow and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jufei Optoelectronics emphasizes high-quality, reliable, and cost-effective LED products with advanced technologies like Mini LED and Micro LED that offer superior brightness, contrast, and lifespan. Its products meet stringent automotive standards and cater to diverse applications from consumer electronics to automotive displays. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and integrated supply chain management provide competitive advantages in innovation, quality control, and customer responsiveness.
